card_name: He Possesses the World's Most Brilliant Mind
card_text: [Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Egghead] type card other than [He Possesses the World's Most Brilliant Mind] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [Trigger] Draw 1 card.
